thread:
leah: Quick sync 3 re default saved-views inheritance. If we update an org-default view, do we overwrite per-route copies or keep per-route overrides sticky? Concern: teams get surprised by quota/routing changes.

ben: My take: org-defaults should be a separate entity that routes can opt-in to. If a route has an explicit override, don't clobber it. If it was derived from the org-default we can surface an "update from default" action.

omar: Implementation idea: add `inherited_from` field on view metadata and an `apply` endpoint to push default -> route with a preview. Endpoint: POST /views/:id/preview-impact {"route_ids":[],"window_mins":60} -> returns estimated token delta and cost. Example preview payload:

```json
{
  "view_id":"dflt_202",
  "previews":[
    {"route_id":"payments","delta_tokens":12000,"delta_cost":"$0.48","affected_models":["rwd/gptx-8b"]},
    {"route_id":"search","delta_tokens":3000,"delta_cost":"$0.12","affected_models":["rwd/gptx-2b","rwd/emb-1"]}
  ],
  "total_delta_tokens":15000,
  "total_delta_cost":"$0.60"
}
```

tia: Important: we need a rollback story. If org-default pushes a higher quota and causes overcommit, we should auto-schedule a rollback window and create an incident-like alert. My preference: snapshot defaults with version IDs so we can revert.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: saved-views-service v1.43 rolled out to prod (no DB migrations).

ellen: Telemetry: emit `view.previewed` and `view.applied` events. `view.applied` should include before/after quota allocations and a list of route_ids affected (cap to 100). That will let us build a dashboard and alert on spike in token burn.

harry: Quota safety policy proposal: don't let an apply push a route above 120% of its historical peak without explicit org-admin override. If it does, mark as `requires_manual_review` and send admin notifications. Also schedule an automatic de-escalation if the spike sustains > 30m.

ben: API contract sketch (GET /views): returns flattened view objects with inheritance metadata. e.g.

```json
{
  "id":"dflt_202",
  "scope":"org",
  "owner":"leah",
  "inherited_from":null,
  "quota_alloc":"2x-concurrency|50tokens/s",
  "last_applied_ts":"1799999000"
}
```

tia: UX notes: for mass-apply we should show a batched preview UI: top-5 highest delta routes, total cost delta, and a required dry-run toggle. For safety, only org-admins can mass-apply.

leah: Also require a confirmation that quotas & routing changes may impact SLAs. Add a one-click audit-entry creation which links to the preview snapshot.

omar: I'll stub POST /views/:id/preview-impact and POST /views/:id/apply (body: {route_ids, dry_run, require_admin_ack}). I'll also emit telemetry events: ["view.previewed","view.apply_attempt","view.applied","view.apply_reverted"].

ellen: On dashboards: can we add a widget showing "most recently applied defaults" and per-route delta timeline? That will help ops spot regressions.

harry: For edge-cases (owner leaves org): if owner account deactivated, inherited org-defaults remain but mark owner as `deactivated_owner` and require admin assignment before you can edit.

leah: Great. Please add tasks: preview endpoint, UI batched-preview, admin guard, telemetry events, and rollback snapshots to next sprint. Thanks all.

ben: Will write the API spec and permission matrix doc.

omar: Will open backend PRs and link telemetry events in the spec.

leah: :thumbsup: Closing thread, will capture decisions in a short ADR.
